name: [TV3] WF-01: Burnout Crisis Detection & Multi-Tier Escalation

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, workflow: 'WF-01 Burnout Crisis', status: 'ACCEPTED', riskTier: $('Data Validation & Sanitize').first().json.riskTier, processedAt: $now.toISO() }) }}

parameters.query: =SELECT u.id, u.full_name, u.email, u.job_title, d.name AS dept_name, m.full_name AS manager_name, m.email AS manager_email FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN users m ON u.manager_id = m.id WHERE u.id = {{ $('Data Validation & Sanitize').first().json.userId }};

=SELECT CAST(COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('mood', t.mood, 'feedback', t.feedback_text, 'date', t.check_date)), JSON_ARRAY()) AS CHAR) AS history_json FROM (SELECT mood, feedback_text, DATE(created_at) AS check_date FROM employee_moods WHERE user_id = {{ $('Data Validation & Sanitize').first().json.userId }} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 7) t;

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Build Alert Card').first().json.emailSubject }}
parameters.ccEmail: ={{ ($('Build Alert Card').first().json.riskTier === 'CRITICAL' && $('Build Alert Card').first().json.managerEmail !== $('Build Alert Card').first().json.hrEmail) ? $('Build Alert Card').first().json.hrEmail : '' }}

parameters.query: =UPDATE employee_moods SET is_burnout_risk = 1 WHERE user_id = {{ $('Data Validation & Sanitize').first().json.userId }} AND mood = 'STRESSED' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND is_burnout_risk = 0;
